about: One adversarial table for the rich-text heading, blockquote and hard_break grammar, run by three validators:
site-starter packages/managed-site-contract (the contract a site builds against),
The file is byte-identical in both repositories; change both copies together:
Each case's constraints are shallow-merged over baseConstraints.
reason is the writer's refusal reason; the contract package reports its own error and is held to outcome only.
writerOnly: a field policy the CMS reader deliberately does not re-judge, so the reader must accept.
contractOnly: a size limit the CMS writer does not enforce yet, so both CMS validators must accept.
hard_break (contract 0.17.0) is an inline node with exactly one key, type, in a paragraph's or heading's content.
A field permits it only with allowHardBreaks: true (absent means false); maxHardBreaks (1 to 16, absent is unbounded) caps the document's total.
A hard_break never leads or ends its block and never sits next to another; text still refuses every control character.
Each hard_break rule is judged at the hard_break's own depth, one reason per node, after the node's key rules, in this order:
not permitted by the field, then at the edge of its block (a neighbour that is not a text node), then next to another.
A break beside an empty text node is refused by that text node's own rule (text node is empty). Marks are examined on text nodes only.
The cap is judged at depth 0 and counts every node whose type is hard_break anywhere in the document, well-formed or not.
